metadata.name: hookwars_armory
metadata.description: Hookwars: the armory (docs/spec/02-armory.md). Templates, items as supply-1 tokens, royalties, equip rules (vote, performance, locked), equipping at launch, loot minting for the war program, forging.

docs: Instructions.

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: The proposed admin accepts.

instructions.name: apply_params
docs: Applies proposed params once the timelock has passed; anyone may send it.

instructions.name: cancel
docs: The proposer cancels an open proposal with no votes (02 section 6.5).

instructions.name: check_performance
docs: Checks a `Performance` slot's condition and reverts it when due (02 section 6.7).

accounts.name: pool
docs: The launch pool (its observation ring is in its tail, 03 M3a notes).

accounts.name: open_proposal
docs: The slot's open proposal, cancelled by a revert.

accounts.name: new_composite
docs: composite; read by the items program's `init_equip`.

instructions.name: claim_royalty
docs: The item's holder claims royalty from one of its royalty holdings (02 section 5.2).

instructions.name: close_proposal
docs: Closes a final proposal once its vote locks are closed; rent to the proposer (02 6.6).

instructions.name: close_vote
docs: Closes a vote lock of a final proposal; rent to the voter (02 section 6.6).

instructions.name: create_composite
docs: Hookwars M3b: anyone authors a composite item (08 section 2) from open templates. The
remaining accounts are each module's `Template`, in module order.

accounts.name: template
docs: The Composite template (id 41).

instructions.name: create_item
docs: Anyone authors an item from an open template (02 section 4.2).

instructions.name: equip_launch
docs: The launchpad equips one slot of a fresh mint (02 section 7.1).

accounts.name: launch_caller
docs: The launchpad's `["armory-caller", mint]` (checked in the handler).

accounts.name: new_composite
docs: composite; read by the items program's `init_equip`.

instructions.name: execute
docs: Applies a passed proposal after its notice (02 section 6.4).

accounts.name: new_composite
docs: composite; read by the items program's `init_equip`.

instructions.name: fail_stale
docs: Fails a passed proposal that no longer fits (02 section 6.4).

instructions.name: finalize
docs: Resolves a proposal once voting ends (02 section 6.4).

accounts.name: launch
docs: passed (security review 1, M-1); when it holds a launch, the two holdings below are required.

instructions.name: forge
docs: Forges two items of one template into one (02 section 9).

instructions.name: fuse
docs: Integration pass 3 (08 wave F, section 2.9): the holder of every component fuses them into
one composite: each component is burned and becomes a module (its template and params, the
targets given here), in order. Remaining accounts: the components' templates in order, then
`(item, item mint (mut), holder's holding (mut))` per component, then the optional suffixes
`create_composite` takes. One-way: there is no unfuse.

accounts.name: template
docs: The Composite template (id 41).

instructions.name: init
docs: Creates the config; the program's upgrade authority signs.

instructions.name: init_counters
docs: Integration pass 2 (10 section 17 I-5): creates `wallet`'s badge counters
(`["authored", wallet]`, `["claimed", wallet]`); permissionless, idempotent.

instructions.name: mint_composite
docs: Integration pass 3 (08 section 2.9): `create_composite` whose module templates must be the
preset's, in its order. Remaining accounts: the preset, then what `create_composite` takes.

accounts.name: template
docs: The Composite template (id 41).

instructions.name: mint_crafted
docs: Integration pass 3 (E-5, 11 section 5.3): craft's output. Only `["craft-signer"]` under
craft may call it; the crafter receives the item (`source = CRAFTED`).

accounts.name: craft_signer
docs: Craft's `["craft-signer"]` (checked in the handler).

instructions.name: mint_loot
docs: The war program mints a loot item (02 section 4.3).

accounts.name: loot_signer
docs: The war program's `["loot-signer"]`.

instructions.name: propose
docs: Proposes an item (or emptying) for a slot (02 section 6.2).

accounts.name: proposer_holding
docs: threshold, locked in place for the vote period; address-checked in the handler).

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: The admin proposes a new admin, who may accept after the timelock.

instructions.name: propose_params
docs: The admin proposes new params; they apply after `admin_timelock_secs` (D-9).

instructions.name: register_preset
docs: Integration pass 3 (08 section 4.8): the admin registers a composite preset (the module
templates in order). Admin-direct like `register_template` (see L-1 in 13-integration-3).

instructions.name: register_template
docs: Registers a template (02 section 3.1).

instructions.name: retire_template
docs: Retires a template (02 section 3.2).

instructions.name: revert_for_lease_end
docs: Integration pass 2 (10 section 17 I-3): the market ends a lease. When `slot` still holds the
leased `item`, it is settled out and reverted to its launch item (or emptied), as a
performance revert does. Signed by `["market-caller"]` under the market.

accounts.name: market_caller
docs: `["market-caller"]` under the market (checked in the handler).

accounts.name: new_composite
docs: composite; read by the items program's `init_equip`.

instructions.name: set_item_protocol_bps
docs: Integration pass 3 (E-2, R37): the admin sets `ITEM_PROTOCOL_BPS`, the protocol's share of
each token-side cut `settle_equip` settles. Admin-direct (see L-1 in 13-integration-3).

instructions.name: set_template_economy
docs: Integration pass 3 (E-7, 11 sections 1.2, 2.2, 5.4): the admin sets a template's economy
fields. Admin-direct like `register_template` and `retire_template` (review 1 L-1 puts all
three behind the timelock; see 13-integration-3).

instructions.name: vote
docs: Votes by locking tokens in place (02 section 6.3).

types.name: ArmoryConfig
docs: `ArmoryConfig` at `["config"]` (02 section 2.1).

fields.name: admin
docs: Registers and retires templates, proposes params.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Proposed admin and when it may accept.

fields.name: items_minted
docs: Seed of the next item mint.

fields.name: templates
docs: Templates registered.

fields.name: params
docs: The numbers.

fields.name: item_protocol_bps
docs: Integration pass 3 (11 section 2.2, R37, E-2): the protocol's share of every token-side cut
`settle_equip` settles, taken first (`ITEM_PROTOCOL_BPS`, to set; 0 until the admin sets
it with `set_economy`). Paid to the admin's holding.

types.name: ArmoryParams
docs: Every number the armory acts on (00 section 6), set by the admin behind `admin_timelock_secs`.

fields.name: max_royalty_bps
docs: `MAX_ROYALTY_BPS`.

fields.name: vote_period_secs
docs: `VOTE_PERIOD_SECS`.

fields.name: vote_quorum_bps
docs: `VOTE_QUORUM_BPS`.

fields.name: min_notice_secs
docs: `MIN_NOTICE_SECS`.

fields.name: max_notice_secs
docs: `MAX_NOTICE_SECS`.

fields.name: forge_gain_bps
docs: `FORGE_GAIN_BPS`.

fields.name: min_twap_secs
docs: `MIN_TWAP_SECS`.

fields.name: max_pool_item_cut_bps
docs: `MAX_POOL_ITEM_CUT_BPS`: the most a Pool or Relation item may cut on one side of a swap.

fields.name: max_pool_item_discount_bps
docs: The most creator and holder fee discount an item may ask for.

fields.name: max_item_reads
docs: The most foreign accounts an item may read.

fields.name: admin_timelock_secs
docs: `ADMIN_TIMELOCK_SECS`: delay on every admin change, this one included.

fields.name: settle_bounty_bps
docs: Hookwars M3b: the bounty `settle_equip` pays its sender, of what it settles
(`MAX_CRANK_BOUNTY_BPS` at most; 04 section 2.5).

fields.name: proposal_min_bps
docs: Security review 1, M-2: the least a proposer must hold, in basis points of the mint's
supply, locked in place for the vote period (0 turns the requirement off). To set.

types.name: AuthorCounter
docs: Integration pass 2 (10 section 17 I-5): `AuthorCounter` at `["authored", wallet]`, bumped by
`create_item` and `create_composite` when passed; read by social badges.

types.name: ClaimCounter
docs: Integration pass 2 (10 section 17 I-5): `ClaimCounter` at `["claimed", wallet]`: bridged-SOL
lamports of royalty the wallet claimed, bumped by `claim_royalty` when passed.

types.name: CompositeItem
docs: Hookwars M3b: a composite's module list at `["composite", item]` (08 section 2.2; the same
layout as `hookwars_common::composite::CompositeItem`).

types.name: EquipConfig
docs: Targets and role chosen by the community that equips an item (04 section 2.3).

fields.name: targets
docs: Targets; their meaning is the template's.

fields.name: role
docs: 0 none; Tribute: 1 Pay, 2 Receive.

types.name: ForgeCounter
docs: `ForgeCounter` at `["forges", wallet]` (02 section 2.10).

types.name: FuseTarget
docs: IDL-only stand-in for the (u8, u8) tuple: identical Borsh layout.

types.name: Item
docs: `Item` at `["item", item_mint]` (02 section 2.4).

fields.name: source
docs: `Authored` 0, `Loot` 1, `Forged` 2.

fields.name: has_wear
docs: Integration pass 3 (E-3): a craft `Wear` exists for this item (made at creation when its
template's `charges_on_create` is above 0); the items engine then reads it last in the
registry and answers the default while it is dormant (R38).

types.name: ItemCrafted
docs: Integration pass 3 (E-5): an item made by craft's `mint_crafted`.

types.name: ItemProtocolBpsSet
docs: Integration pass 3 (E-2).

types.name: LaunchEquip
docs: One slot at launch (02 section 7.1; M2: one slot per call).

types.name: Manifest
docs: What an item may do, computed once from its template and params (04 section 2.7; 16 bytes).

fields.name: kind
docs: Slot kind.

fields.name: token_flags
docs: Token flags (upstream bits plus `ANSWERS_TOUCH`); 0 without token callbacks.

fields.name: pool_flags
docs: Pool flags; 0 without pool callbacks.

fields.name: max_cut_buy_bps
docs: Worst-case pool cut on a buy.

fields.name: max_cut_sell_bps
docs: Worst-case pool cut on a sell.

fields.name: max_cut_transfer_bps
docs: Worst-case token-side cut on a transfer.

fields.name: max_discount_bps
docs: Largest creator and holder fee discount.

fields.name: may_refuse
docs: Can fail a transfer.

fields.name: may_burn
docs: Answers a burn.

fields.name: data_bytes
docs: Range bytes used, without the epoch byte.

fields.name: reads_other_pools
docs: Foreign accounts it reads.

types.name: Module
docs: One module of a composite (08 2.2).

fields.name: template_id
docs: A composable template.

fields.name: params
docs: Its fields (written out: the IDL builder cannot follow the `Params` alias).

fields.name: target_start
docs: First of its targets in the equip's targets.

fields.name: target_count
docs: How many targets.

fields.name: data_bytes
docs: Its sub-range length (its manifest's `data_bytes`).

fields.name: reads_module
docs: An earlier module whose bytes it may read, or [`NO_READ`].

types.name: PendingParams
docs: Params waiting out the timelock at `["pending-params"]`.

types.name: PerformanceRule
docs: The `Performance` rule (02 section 6.7, 16 bytes).

fields.name: metric
docs: `QuoteVolume` 0, `Twap` 1, `SwapCount` 2.

fields.name: window_secs
docs: The window measured.

fields.name: base_window_secs
docs: The longer window it is compared with.

fields.name: op
docs: `Below` 0, `Above` 1.

fields.name: ratio_bps
docs: `rate(window) op rate(base_window) * ratio_bps / 10_000`.

fields.name: hold_secs
docs: How long it must hold.

types.name: Pool
docs: A pool at `["pool", base_mint, quote_mint, lp_fee_bps, hook_program or default]`.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump of the pool PDA.

fields.name: lp_mint_bump
docs: Bump of the LP mint PDA `["lp", pool]`.

fields.name: base_mint
docs: Base mint.

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: Quote mint.

fields.name: lp_mint
docs: LP mint (a BTS mint whose authority is the pool).

fields.name: base_vault
docs: The pool's holding of the base mint.

fields.name: quote_vault
docs: The pool's holding of the quote mint.

fields.name: hook_program
docs: Hook program, if any.

fields.name: hook_flags
docs: Which callbacks run (`bordrless_hook::pool_flags`).

fields.name: lp_fee_bps
docs: LP fee in basis points of the input; stays in the pool.

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps
docs: Flat protocol fee in basis points (`FEE_MODEL_FLAT`), always charged in the quote token: of
what reaches the vault on a buy, of the curve's output on a sell. Accrued for the fee
collector. 0 under the share model.

fields.name: base_reserve
docs: Real base reserve (the base vault's balance).

fields.name: quote_reserve
docs: Real quote reserve (the quote vault's balance minus accrued protocol fees).

fields.name: virtual_base
docs: Virtual base offset used for pricing.

fields.name: virtual_quote
docs: Virtual quote offset used for pricing.

fields.name: lp_supply
docs: LP shares outstanding, including the minimum liquidity the pool keeps.

fields.name: protocol_fees_quote
docs: Protocol fees accrued (always in the quote token), sitting in the quote vault apart from
the reserve until `collect_protocol_fees`.

fields.name: curve
docs: A curve: virtual offsets live, no LP minted yet, liquidity locked until finalized.

fields.name: creator
docs: Who created the pool (the deposit authority).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation time.

fields.name: last_swap_at
docs: Time of the last swap.

fields.name: swap_count
docs: Swaps so far.

fields.name: base_volume
docs: Base traded so far (both directions).

fields.name: quote_volume
docs: Quote traded so far (both directions).

fields.name: hook_signer_bump
docs: Bump of `["hook-authority", hook_program]`, this program's signer of every callback to the
pool's hook (one per hook program, so a hook can tell its own callbacks from a signer
another hook passed on); 0 without a hook.

fields.name: fee_model
docs: How the protocol fee is taken: `FEE_MODEL_FLAT` (a rate of the quote, ordinary pools) or
`FEE_MODEL_SHARE` (a share of what the hooks cut, launch pools). Fixed at creation.

fields.name: protocol_share_bps
docs: Under `FEE_MODEL_SHARE`: Bordrless's share of what the hooks cut on each swap, in basis
points of the cuts, taken in the quote (base-side cuts valued at the swap's own price). 0
under the flat model.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

types.name: Preset
docs: Integration pass 3 (08 section 4.8): a composite preset at `["preset", id]`: the module
templates in order; each minted composite chooses its own params inside their ceilings.

types.name: PresetRegistered
docs: Integration pass 3 (08 section 4.8): a composite preset registered.

types.name: Proposal
docs: `Proposal` at `["proposal", mint, slot, nonce]` (02 section 2.8).

fields.name: item
docs: `None` empties the slot.

fields.name: config
docs: Targets and role of the equip (04 section 2.3).

fields.name: voters_open
docs: `VoteLock` accounts not yet closed (the proposal closes after them).

types.name: RegisterTemplateArgs
docs: Arguments of `register_template` (02 section 3.1).

fields.name: id
docs: The template id: `ArmoryConfig.templates + 1` (04 reserves 0 for "none").

types.name: SlotState
docs: `SlotState` at `["slot-state", mint, slot]` (02 section 2.7).

fields.name: equip_rule
docs: The slot's equip rule (copied from the mint at launch).

fields.name: notice_secs
docs: Delay between a passed vote and its equip, fixed at launch.

fields.name: launch_config
docs: The launch item's targets and role: a performance revert re-aims it the same way.

types.name: Template
docs: `Template` at `["template", id]` (02 section 2.3).

fields.name: max_targets
docs: Most targets an equip of its items may name (M2 notes: the manifest promises the most).

fields.name: status
docs: `Active` 0, `Retired` 1.

fields.name: author_bps
docs: Integration pass 3 (E-7, 11 sections 1.2, 2.2, 5.4): the template author's share of each
item royalty and licence (R34), the access mode new items get, the modes allowed, and the
charges an item of this template starts with (0 = never wears).

types.name: TemplateEconomySet
docs: Integration pass 3 (E-7).

types.name: VoteLock
docs: `VoteLock` at `["vote", proposal, voter]` (02 section 2.9).
